stations.title: Imogen
stations.say: Why is the label code broken now?

stations.title: Order code
stations.text: Writes an order line out in every function.

captions: Imogen asks why a function at Oakhollow broke when nobody changed it.
The order line was written out twice, and only one copy got the grams per tin.
You give each shape a name, and every function uses the name.
Now the order line is written once, and both functions see the same shape.
The shop's shapes have names, so a change reaches every place that uses them.
